Title: Murder of Gedaliah
KeyPersons: Gedaliah, Son of Ahikam; Ishmael, Son of Nethaniah; Johanan, Son of Kareah
Events: Ishmael son of Nethaniah, though warned against, murders Gedaliah, Babylon's governor of the remnant, at Mizpah and massacres his men, and Johanan son of Kareah recovers the captives from him at Gibeon.
